about_the_game:
This game is a traditional Chinese-style simulation building game that integrates efficiency tools. Travel around the world, discover new settlements,

Every time you use efficiency tools to focus on creation, it will bring changes to the settlement.

Discover new areas: coastal fishing villages, mountain valleys, and so on and so forth.

Help villagers build public facilities, or build magnificent but not very practical buildings simply for the sake of landscape. Or if you work hard enough, perhaps you can pursue both strategies simultaneously.

A tree that fills your arms grows from a tiny sprout; a nine-story tower rises from a heap of earth; a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

It is hoped that this game can bring you joy and a sense of achievement in your daily work and study. Every effort you make is a solid step towards your goal.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (or Higher)
  • Processor: Dual-core from Intel or AMD at 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or DirectX 10 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (or Higher)
  • Processor: Intel i3 or equivalent AMD processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 11 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
